content.user_title: Plan McDonald's Meals by Nutrition and Budget
content.value_statement: Choosing meals within nutrition and budget limits requires checking menus, serving sizes, and discounts. Chilemai combines current MCP data with local meal planning and confirmed ordering.
actual_capabilities: Guide store selection using location, distance, opening status, and the selected pickup or delivery mode.
Parse the MCP nutrition text format and match menu names after punctuation and whitespace normalization.
Separate exact nutrition matches from uncertain candidates and unmatched products.
Generate meals containing one to three single-item portions and check combined nutrition against selected limits.
Guide coupon collection, store-specific eligibility checks, and official price comparisons before budget confirmation.
Guide confirmed order creation, return payment links, and verify order status without blindly retrying uncertain creations.
limitations: Live menus and ordering require a configured McDonald's China MCP connection, an account token, and service availability.
The bundled script requires Python 3.8 or later; it processes local data and does not connect to MCP or pay for orders.
Automatic planning covers one to three single-item portions, excludes bundles and uncertain matches, and estimates prices without discounts or delivery fees.
Nutrition coverage is incomplete and lacks sugar values; recommendations are not medical advice or guarantees about blood glucose.

use_cases.title: Choose lunch near work
use_cases.description: Find an open pickup store, compare meals against a lunch budget, and review the final official price before ordering.

use_cases.title: Compare meals by nutrition
use_cases.description: Check combined calories and protein using confirmed single-item matches, while excluding products with missing or ambiguous nutrition.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a team meal
use_cases.description: Follow the group-order workflow using headcount, delivery details, promotions, assistance-service parameters, and explicit approval of the final order.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a pickup meal
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose McDonald's lunch for pickup in Hangzhou near West Lake. My budget is 40 yuan. Show a recommendation before ordering.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: choose a store and meal.

prompt_templates.title: Apply nutrition limits
prompt_templates.prompt: Find a pickup meal near West Lake in Hangzhou with at most 500 kcal and at least 25 g protein. Use confirmed nutrition matches.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: check nutrition across the whole meal.

prompt_templates.title: Compare final prices
prompt_templates.prompt: For my selected store, compare two nutrition-qualified meals with applicable coupons. Check official totals against 40 yuan, including fees. Wait for confirmation before ordering.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare coupons and final payable amounts.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a group delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare McDonald's delivery for 12 colleagues within 480 yuan. Ask me to confirm the address and time. Check promotions and required group-service parameters.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate group ordering and approval.

output_examples.input: I want McDonald's lunch in Hangzhou near West Lake, within 40 yuan.
output_examples.output: Would you like pickup, delivery, or drive-through? I need the ordering mode before checking stores and current prices.

output_examples.input: Can you use a burger's nutrition values for the three-item bundle?
output_examples.output: No. I need the selected burger, side, drink, serving sizes, and quantities before calculating the bundle's total nutrition.

output_examples.input: The order creation request timed out. Try again.
output_examples.output: I will check existing orders first. If creation remains uncertain, I will leave it pending verification instead of creating a second order.

best_practices: Confirm the ordering mode, location, serving sizes, and nutrition limits before selecting a meal.
Verify menu price units and use official calculated totals, including applicable fees, for budget decisions.
Approve the exact order details before creation, and check existing orders when creation results are uncertain.
anti_patterns: Treating a bundle as one burger when calculating total nutrition.
Assuming uncertain matches or missing nutrition values satisfy dietary constraints.
Promising final prices from menu estimates or creating orders without explicit confirmation.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Configure the McDonald's China MCP service with your token. Local nutrition matching and planning also require Python 3.8 or later.

faq.question: Which ordering modes are documented?
faq.answer: The workflows cover store pickup, delivery, drive-through, and group dining. Availability depends on the selected store and MCP service.

faq.question: Does the skill make payments automatically?
faq.answer: No. It requires explicit confirmation before creating an order and gives the returned payment link to the user.

faq.question: Are all products covered by nutrition data?
faq.answer: No. Unmatched items and uncertain serving sizes cannot support strict nutrition checks. Bundles require separate composition and serving verification.

faq.question: Does the planner guarantee the final price?
faq.answer: No. It estimates menu subtotals. Official price calculation must verify coupons, delivery charges, packaging fees, and the final payable amount.

faq.question: Can this skill provide medical nutrition advice?
faq.answer: No. Nutrition values support meal comparisons only. The data lacks sugar measurements and cannot establish blood glucose effects.
